title: Predicting Information Pathways Across Online Communities

problem.claim: Community-level information pathway prediction aims to predict how content is transmitted across online communities.

gap.claim: The task is difficult because inter-community relationships and influence are unknown, information spread is multi-modal, and new content and communities emerge over time.

contributions.claim: The work collects large-scale, multi-modal datasets of online YouTube video diffusion on Reddit.
The work constructs community influence graphs and develops INPAC, a dynamic graph framework for modeling temporal variability and multi-modal propagation across communities.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe INPAC as a novel dynamic graph framework.

author_reported_evidence.claim: In warm-start and cold-start experiments, INPAC outperforms seven baselines for community-level information pathway prediction.
The authors report that their code and datasets are publicly available.

narrative_sequence.summary: Defines community-level information pathway prediction as forecasting content transmission across online communities.
Motivates the task by its potential to distribute valuable information and limit misinformation.
Identifies unknown influence relationships, multi-modal spread, and temporal emergence of content and communities as key challenges.
Introduces datasets, community influence graphs, and the INPAC dynamic graph framework for Reddit video diffusion.
Reports performance gains over seven baselines in warm-start and cold-start settings and provides code and datasets.

source_observation.claim: The framework incorporates community influence graphs to model temporal and multi-modal propagation.

interpretation.claim: Modeling both changing inter-community influence and multiple propagation modes may be useful for pathway prediction.

application.claim: For cross-community diffusion tasks, represent influence relationships explicitly and account for temporal and multi-modal behavior.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this approach generalizes beyond YouTube videos diffusing on Reddit.

unknowns: Dataset sizes, features, and construction details are not provided.
The INPAC architecture, training procedure, evaluation metrics, and quantitative results are not provided.
The identities and implementation details of the seven baselines are not provided.
